dashboard.label: Vue d'ensemble de l'ingestion
dashboard.description: Volumes par index / sourcetype, latence d'indexation, santé de la chaîne SC4S / Kafka / Logstash

search.query: | tstats count where index=* index!=_* by _time, index span=5m | timechart span=5m sum(count) by index
index=* index!=_* | eval lag=_indextime-_time | stats count avg(lag) as avg_lag p95(lag) as p95_lag max(lag) as max_lag by sourcetype | sort - p95_lag
index=app_heartbeat | timechart span=1m count by host
| tstats count where index=net* OR index=os* OR index=main by sourcetype, host | sort - count | head 20
index=_internal source=*metrics.log group=queue blocked=true | timechart span=5m count by host
index=_internal source=*license_usage.log type=Usage | timechart span=1h sum(eval(b/1024/1024/1024)) as GB by idx
